This is it. The holy grail of automated Equivalent Exchange. By upgrading an Alchemical Chest and stripping away its localized magical resonance, you have re-routed all its internal energy toward a single, singular purpose: absolute matter conversion. You are no longer transforming items by hand; you have engineered a machine that fundamentally overwrites reality, turning garbage into gold. Words are honestly useless here—you simply need to build one and witness the magic for yourself.

Functionally, the Energy Condenser loses the ability to activate rings and amulets, but gains the ultimate transmutation mechanic. By placing a "Target Item" in the top-left slot, the Condenser will ruthlessly devour any non-target items pumped into its inventory, converting their EMC value directly into the target item. Furthermore, it can absorb raw EMC pumped in from adjacent Energy Collectors and Anti-Matter Relays, acting as the ultimate automated replicator for your factory.
